attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Two homesteads on the Merrow road remain lost to their raiders","severity":"major","reason":"The briefing says the homesteads were raided and lost stores, not that they are still lost or held."},{"span":"traders travel in pairs to pay the toll","severity":"major","reason":"No toll is mentioned anywhere; this invents a fact and a cause."},{"span":"moving northward","severity":"major","reason":"The briefing gives no direction for the Kinn's movement."},{"span":"keep the Kinn of the Long Grass moving","severity":"minor","reason":"This presents the earlier grass-fire news as an ongoing current situation."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"On a quiet week this rehashes old news as if it were current, and it recycles earlier jokes almost verbatim (doubled prices, trouble finding someone).
